crossRefs.note: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken…

translations.web: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.
translations.bsb: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:
translations.kjv: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
translations.asv: Hear then ye the parable of the sower.
